notes.title: Update 1.38.0
notes.content:
1.38.0  (28.02.2025)

- Fixed isues with colonization.
- New 30-day reward calendar
- Promotions
- The red warehouses bug has been fixed
- The velocities of cosmic bodies are aligned with the server
- Fixing minor bugs


1.37.6 (01.02.2025)

- Kick all marauders, that steal Am from you, with one click.
- Fixed stucking in tutorial for old returning players.
- Report issues when losses were not shown, and 0 restored shown, fixed.


1.37.5 (13.01.2025)

- Fixed size issues in windowed mode for desktop clients, added window mode setting in Player Settings.
- Fixed camera rotation freeze after opening awards panel.
- When you close the chat, an unsent message is saved.
- Fixed a bug when the chat was missing


1.37.4 (11.01.2025)

- Fixed a bug when the file explorer did not open to send images in the chat and when uploading avatars for new android versions


1.37.4 (09.01.2025)

- Fixed a bug on the fleet dispatch screen when ships automatically switched without player input
- Fixed the problem of training failure if pirate wreckage is overdue or cleaned up by someone
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to waste nanobots
- Fixed a visual bug where resources/credits/nanobots were not updated after receiving a daily or holiday gift
- Fixed a bug where the ratings description would not open


1.37.2 (27.12.2024)

- Added the ability to disable the launch of 3D combat


1.37.2 (26.12.2024)

- Holiday rewards
- Initial training does not require successful completion of the arcade
- Everything is reduced to a single formula: maximum number of planets = Exploration of planets
- Fixed a bug where the description of the guns in the Dock was missing
- Fixed a bug when a report was not sent to the chat in manual combat mode.


1.37.1 (18.11.2024)

- Fixed an issue that caused the tutorial to break down for some players and it was impossible to complete it.
- Fixed an issue where some players had non-clickable elements on the bridge.
- Fixed a problem with uploading avatars in the profile
- Fixed an issue where no reward was awarded for the construction of small and large energy buildings
- Fixed a problem when trying to rename a planet, it was impossible to close the menu
- Now in the galaxy, in the menu of favorite planets, the desired system opens when clicked
- Removed the limit on the total number of rewards in the Asteroids mission

notes.title: Update 1.35.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44110013/5313bc39c1045db309f10475fed038bd922a5993.jpg[/img]

In this update of our online space strategy, a dangerous threat awaits you - space raiders. Defeating the enemy requires careful planning and a strategic approach.

What's new: 
- Space Raiders: A new type of opponents, for defeating which you can get valuable resources
- New tasks: Special tasks aimed at combating the pirate threat
- Daily beginner's reward for entering the game
- Bug fixes. Optimization

notes.title: Update 1.32.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44110013/abeefc0b8a7076d68cd4e3b14a8a6bee90e2918b.png[/img]

Arrange the fleet, divide it into units, set goals and use the unique abilities of ships to defeat the enemy! Colossus, Corvette, Destroyer and Bombardier can now perform special attacks.

The game has a new section with tasks – the "Colonial Development Plan". Explore new planets, develop your base and discover new technologies.

We have taken into account player feedback and significantly improved the gameplay management. The interface in game scenes has also been updated.

Go back to the Galaxy!
Improved user interaction with the game. Minor fixes.

notes.title: In-game chat update!
notes.content:
New update in War For Galaxy: new chat system with improved performance, localized notifications and the ability to send pictures! Immerse yourself in a world of endless battles and enjoy improved communication with other players. Join the epic saga today and become part of the incredible world of War For Galaxy! 



Major innovations:
[olist]
[*]  Fully localized notifications for the English version.
[*]  Added ability to send pictures to in-game chat!
[*]  Completely rewritten chat from the ground up to improve performance significantly!
[/olist]



Enjoy the new features and improved game experience!

notes.title: The new ship "Marauder"!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44110013/fafff465b7809b87edbac5619653988d78f5bc0a.jpg[/img]

[b]In the next update:[/b]

- The space "Marauder" is elusive! He lives outside the law and does not obey the rules of States or international organizations. Use the ship to capture valuable resources of other players. The "Theft" function has been added to the "Fleet" section.

Stay in the game to fend off enemy attacks.

[b]In future updates:[/b]

- New quest system and spectacular battles of space fleets.
